data.name: Chandrashekhar
data.gender_notes: Chandrashekhar is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Chandrashekhar is a Sanskrit name derived from the Sanskrit words chandra (moon) and shekhar (power, king). This name signifies the one who holds the power of the moon god. The name Chandrashekhar carries the meaning “Moon–God's–Power” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Chandrashekhar usually hope their child will grow to embody moon–god's–power and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name symbolizing divine power and connection with the moon.
data.etymology: Chandrashekhar belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Moon–God's–Power.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Chandrashekhar total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
